searchText: I wrote an article about checksumming a dapp like the Launchpad. This is not released widely yet so please give me some feedback, especially if you think this won't work very well. https://jpitts.medium.com/how-to-checksum-a-dapp-e865d952310c If you can link to a gist with the actual contents between the pipes in the final command, that would be nice for context. To read what the summary actually looks like, instead of just straight from input URL to output checksum Oh that is a good one! Also, if the summary contains relative paths, it may be reproducible with a local clone. Nice start on this though 👍 Thx, y will definitely keep trying to get to that, reproducing the result from git commit is ideal.
